reason: I don't know this shop and nothing here says I can get swatches or real daylight photos, so I'd stick with the sellers I already trust on Allegro. The price is fine, but I've wasted money before on colours that looked nothing like the screen.
objection: The colour won't match what I see on screen, and I'll find out after it's already been cut to order. Then there's the worry that the one I want ends up out of stock or stuck on pre-order.
would_change_my_mind: Cheap sample swatches (or a sample box) sent to my InPost locker, plus daylight photos of the actual fabric and clear stock status on each product.
